name: Brainrot Button Panic
hint: Read the arrow. OPPOSITE reverses it. Tap the corresponding pad.

name: Meme Dodge Arena
hint: Drag or steer. Space dashes briefly. Circles warn before impact.

name: One Pixel Survival
hint: Drag the tiny dot through the opening in each moving laser.

name: Impossible Parking
hint: Left/right steer. Up accelerates, down reverses. Space brakes.

name: Reaction Relay
hint: Tap after GO. Early taps lose a life. Reaction time is measured.

name: Chaos Elevator
hint: Choose a floor. Stop on guest floors and carry them to matching numbers.

name: Don't Press Red
hint: Tap green only. Let red expire. Build eight correct decisions.

name: Fall Forever
hint: Steer left/right or drag. Hold Space to brake your descent.

name: Physics Disaster
hint: Cut a support. The falling weight must hit the bell and spare the bomb.

name: Paint Frontier
hint: Leave your blue territory and return to capture space. Avoid the eraser.

name: Notebook Platformer
objective: TAKE THE CORE TO THE EXIT!
hint: Move left/right, jump with Space. Collect the core and land at EXIT.
